Context: 4. Absorption in ABs/PSUs, etc.

Central Government employees are often sent on deputation in public interest to Central Public Sector Undertakings/ Autonomous Bodies or go on their own volition applying in response to advertisements and get permanently absorbed there. Orders of permanent absorption have to be issued by the undertaking in consultation with the parent employer. Retrospective absorption is not permissible.
